fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects the launch of a child process via "conhost.exe" with the "--headless" flag.
The "--headless" flag hides the windows from the user upon execution.
fields.name: Headless Process Launched Via Conhost.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "\\conhost.exe" and src.process.cmdline contains "--headless"))
